card.text: Explore Paaliaq, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Paaliaq’s light curve has four brightness peaks per rotation. This ellipsoid illustrates its small minimum elongation with assumed depth and orientation; it does not reproduce that complex light curve. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.05:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
